notes.comparison: QA P06: Randrelief gegen P05 erkennbar prüfen.
notes.global: QA P06: Materialroute und Spielabstand, keine Nutzerabnahme.

assets.after_closed_hall: QA P06: Abrieb an der Hallenfront prüfen — äöü.

verification.material_route: Intentionally revised: ground/rock/building wear is part of P06, not a constant material assumption.
verification.scope: Relief limited to protected geology envelopes; finer erosion and material wear. Playable hex centers, paths/pads, height/LOS facts, ships/citizens/Astra and global lighting are not migrated.
verification.remaining_visual_differences: Playable ground remains flat and real relief is limited to the existing protected geology envelopes. Cliff masses/crowns remain broad and prismatic. The2Dreferences retain more small depressions, denser usage detail and richer composition. Wear concerns authored closed shells; original GLB cutaways/citizens/ships remain unchanged. Technical checks are not user artistic or general performance/release acceptance.
verification.ship_user_status: Retained criticized R02 models; separate Astra work is not automatically adopted.

data.status: material candidate frozen for parent integration; no artistic user approval

material_route.painted_surfaces: Shared ShaderMaterial per original color and semantic role (paint, roof, structure, base); building-relative static fields, local component AABB instance uniforms for selected edge wear.
material_route.preserved: Original StandardMaterial3D color/energy route for glass, emissive strips/windows, narrow graphic markings and deep gaps; numeric properties checked against P05.
material_route.wear_hierarchy: Metre-scale soft pigment and broad faded upper fields; weaker middle brush scale; base dust and sparse long facade wash; only selected physical edges receive small dark undercoat scuffs.
material_route.visual_adjustment: First opened native study too faint. Broad/middle amplitude increased0.22/0.065 to0.38/0.075; upper bleaching and base dust increased with all noise frequencies unchanged.
material_route.strength_zero_control: Same new shader route with wear_strength0 matches P05 StandardMaterial rendering nearly exactly; direct numerical evidence retained.

preserved_contract.geometry: All generated mesh arrays and transforms match P05 SHA256 fingerprints, including normals and indices.
preserved_contract.bounds: P05 AABBs unchanged including signs; original XZ+0.22m and height+0.20m retained.
preserved_contract.visibility: all parts remain under same existing closed/cutaway root; no process/update loop added
preserved_contract.lights_and_gameplay: No lighting/environment, collision/nav, door/interior, simulation or source-asset change.
preserved_contract.shader_motion: No vertex displacement, normal perturbation or TIME-driven animation.

render_response.scope: Same static camera/light, whole-image deltas incl. unchanged background; tests clean PBR-route equivalence and actual nontrivial shader response, not artistic quality. Isolated probe shadow dither remains present in both states.

qa.scope: Full generated vertices/normals/triangle areas, clockwise normal consistency, closed welded topology per mesh, XZ/height envelopes, hierarchy and conservative component-AABB connectivity. Not a general geometry intersection/zfight oracle.
qa.limits: AABB connectivity remains conservative, not an exact intersection/zfight oracle. Checks and image deltas do not imply artistic approval or general performance/release acceptance.

visual_review.findings: Compared same-camera P05/zero-wear/after images. Broad roof fading and warmer lower dust now visibly break the clean uniform fields; sparse downward marks appear on selected fascia zones. Original silhouette, glass, signs and warm lights remain readable.
visual_review.remaining_differences: Still much cleaner and less individually painted than the rich illustrations; edge chips are intentionally sparse and remain small at game distance. No sculpted corrosion/depth or texture-authoring pass.
visual_review.probe_limitation: The isolated probe has fine checker/shadow-dither visible in the background and both old/new states. It is not a new wear pattern; parent combined native captures do not show it and remain the main visual evidence.
visual_review.acceptance: candidate review only, not user art acceptance

data.production_capture: Parent owns combined scene captures/strict suite/report and frozen model-hash verification. This package does not claim those as performed here.
data.branch: task/grafikreferenzen-20261101, intentional continuation of the unintegrated graphics branch

data.status: frozen geometry and technically verified candidate; user visual acceptance pending

visual_review.isolated_pairs: P05/P06 geometry with identical respective loaded P06 shader/profile/light/camera per pair; not historical P05 material equality
visual_review.independent: ship_sources reopened final near_detail_after and landscape_after after height clamp: no gross holes, suspended main bodies or detached feet; no user art acceptance
visual_review.changes: bounded interrupted V-shaped erosion channels with unequal height windows and slight lateral drift; fourteen actual multi-band lobed sediment/talus fans ending below the flat ground
visual_review.remaining: large plateau caps and some wall faces remain broad; erosion is simplified low-poly geometry and still less rich than illustration; relief deliberately confined to blocked envelopes

data.failed_attempts: earlier strict runs preserved; relief slope limiter was tightened until minimum normalY0.47185 exceeded unchanged0.45 threshold. Final14 rock/relief contract and10 new relief checks passed.

data.status: Native Godot shader/dressing revision on unintegrated graphics branch; no user art approval.
scope: localized cliff wash and broken strata paint
paving aggregate scuff and selective marking loss
data.geometry_route: Existing continuous flat plane and unchanged road/apron geometry. Real blocked-area relief belongs to the separate geology package.
data.preserved: Nine primary GLBs, original characters/animation, shared light, Hex facts, actor starts and cameras.
data.material_route: World-coordinate integer hash noise; shared/cached ShaderMaterial for soil, cliffs, paving and marking colors. No per-frame mesh rebuilding.
data.limits: Procedural paint; no hand-painted texture bake. Walkable soil remains flat. Fine painted wear is intentionally quieter at strategic distance.
